# Adi Music

> A free, open-source music player for the browser. Play your own audio files with synced lyrics, a 10-band equalizer, playlists and offline listening. Files stay on the user's device; there are no accounts.

## Pages

- [Home](<!--# echo var="public_url" -->/): what Adi Music does, how to start, FAQ
- [Privacy](<!--# echo var="public_url" -->/privacy): what is stored and which requests the app makes

## Source

- [GitHub](https://github.com/nationdex/music): code, issues, Android and iOS app
